'''2001 Colorado State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Colorado in 2001. [[John Arendt]] won it.<ref name="dt-15568">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15568 Dark Surgeon], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15568/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15568/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 2 April)
* '''Site:''' Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Arendt]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Arendt won the Colorado state championship with Alex Tennet's Dark Agents Of Black Sun deck, which did not lose a game there.<ref name="dt-15568" /> His Light deck was his own There Is Good In Him scouts list, "Scouts of Doom".<ref name="dt-14996" /> Chris Fanchi posted his Dark My Kind Of Scum deck as the top-finishing Dark deck at the event; it went 3–0 (+78).<ref name="dt-14973" />
